blocks.title: Transforming energy across the land.
blocks.intro: We solve complex problems for onshore wind investors, developers and operators of onshore wind farms.

elements.text: World class services across the lifecycle of your project

elements.html:
Onshore wind has proven itself to be a clean and productive source of energy generation. LR supports the development and operation of onshore wind projects across the global sector, applying experience and expertise from mature markets to those which are at an earlier stage of development. 

 We solve complex problems for onshore wind investors, developers and operators of onshore wind farms. With our broad range of expertise, we can reduce technical, operational and commercial risks while enhancing asset performance. 

Our services include Site assessment, Energy resource assessment, Risk management, Grid connections, Performance optimisation, Owner’s engineer, Technology qualification and Technical Adjudication.

We apply our expert solutions and independence to assure the integrity, reliability and success of every aspect of your operation. Helping maximise productivity and recovery, reduce operating costs, mitigate risk and demonstrate compliance with government regulations, industry codes and standards, many of which we have helped to develop.
